vb_textbox.text: I couldn't find a clear pattern but when I was stuck, I would just pick a side to choose from and I believe that the average number of mushrooms should equal out to a higher number if I just chose left or right continuously. I tried looking at the gnome color, gnome type, basket color, and forest type. I believe the greener forest had more mushrooms and the brighter colored gnomes would lead you to the greener forest. However, I am not really confident about that. I think my best advice would be to just test out theories and see if you're wrong or right.
